details:
Picture 1. People will sometime share instance links like this

(link: https://booth.pm/ja/items/8425617 / https://vrch.at/t2vmde8v )

This leads to:

https://vrchat.com/home/launch?worldId=wrld_8b5b003d-b5c4-4a20-9035-3d40d81dd927&instanceId=26948~private(usr_582faea0-d73e-4371-af1e-06459cb9209e)~region(jp)&shortName=t2vmde8v

Picture 2. Which will be 'Couldn't load this instance' error since it's assigned to a no longer exist private(invite) instance

Picture 3. I first tried to remove the last part(shortName=) since I want to access the world itself. Weirdly, but I think it did opened the instance for the author? I tried on other usr_  ID but didn't work, seems like this required to use the 'Share/Locked link' in the first place, I tried on group public links but even removing shortName= and change the instance ID it will still link to the very instance, so I'm not sure about the private link since it require another person to test lol.

Picture 4.  People on Twitter or other SNS sharing the public link with shortcut due to the clean look or the word limits, since it have the 'shortName=' part to link it to the people made the link, the instance name became the author's instance name(which is something can be mis-used, btw)

Picture 5. This one shared Friend only link to introduce the world, the no one expect his friends can see the link, but if you edit out the 'shortName=' you can see the newly opend instance of his friend only setting, but just like the Picture 3, the invite me won't work

Picture 6. Finally, to be further testing it, I got the locked link from the friend list, open the browser with ""Incognito mode"", and use the same trick to access the private instance page, guess what, seems like if you have the locked link, you can somewhat stalk strangers. I assume people can use the crawler or API to get the link, or it can be leaked by simply accessing from the website link via the social

Anyway, the bugs:

1. Instance title keeps as long as the  'shortName=' is linked to the creator of the link

2. Although you can't join or see whos inside, you can totally see private instance titles and number of people as long as you probe the link out, I assume this also works on invite only instances, which can be big issue if people wants to do things secretly(I mean, it's their own invite only world, it can be anything with strong instance titles which shouldn't never be public viewed). Even people can't crawl or obtain it from the API, this info shouldn't be provided to anyone don't have access anyhow(include what world, and what instance title, numbers of people)

And the lastly, I also suggested:

1. People clicks the link most likely wants to access the world itself, the page should always show what the world is(or was), otherwise people will requires to edit the link(if they know which part to delete)

2. Add a shortcut text field for world sharing, instead of the instance sharing
title: [1953] 'Couldn't load this instance' access issue and privacy bug
